articles.title: Carney says Canada at ‘crucial time’ in conversation with Quebec premier-designate
articles.summary: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney says he spoke with Quebec premier-designate Paul St-Pierre Plamondon after the Parti Québécois won a minority mandate in Monday's provincial election.

articles.title: Police seek public’s help finding missing 6-year-old girl last seen in Whitby
articles.summary: The Durham Regional Police Service (DRPS) are asking for the public’s assistance in locating a missing six-year-old girl who was last seen in Whitby over the weekend. articles.title: Oprah Winfrey taps a ‘riveting’ debut novel for her book club
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — A debut novel about a 12-year-old girl's struggles to find herself amid poverty and family strife is Oprah Winfrey's new book club pick.

articles.title: ‘Heartbreaking’: Historic Toronto rooming house tenants face uncertain future as Hydro One expansion moves ahead
articles.summary: Tenants living in a historic downtown Toronto rooming house are scrambling to find new accommodations amid uncertainty over when they may have to leave after learning the property has been sold to Hydro One for a planned infrastructure expansion. articles.title: Critical injuries reported in head-on collision near Hamilton
articles.summary: Critical injuries are being assessed after a head-on collision near Hamilton Tuesday, Ontario Provincial Police say. Emergency services were called to the scene on Highway 5 just east of Highway 8 after 7 a.m. There’s no word on how many people were injuried in the crash. articles.title: Toronto-bound QEW reopens on Burlington Skyway after crash
articles.summary: The Toronto-bound lanes of the Queen Elizabeth Way (QEW) have reopened following a crash on the Burlington Skyway. Ontario Provincial Police were called to the collision just before 7 a.m. The crash resulted in a vehicle fire, but no injuries have been reported at this time.

articles.title: Father tells court he feels loss every day after son killed outside Scarborough gas station
articles.summary: The father of a tow truck driver killed outside a Scarborough gas station told a court on Monday he feels the loss of his son every single day.

articles.title: Family pleads for safe return of beloved bunny Biscuit after pet goes missing at Markham Fair
articles.summary: A Toronto family says it's "devastated" after their beloved pet bunny Biscuit went missing at the annual Markham Fair, with both the family and fair organizers saying they believe he was stolen.

articles.title: 2 charged, 1 suspect outstanding in connection with death of Scarborough man found inside burning vehicle
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and one suspect remains outstanding in connection with the death of a Scarborough man found inside a burning vehicle in September, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Crown says DNA evidence helped ID man now on trial for decades-old sex assaults against children
articles.summary: Prosecutors told a jury in Brampton, Ont., on Monday, how DNA evidence had linked three brutal attacks against children in the 1990s to Richard Neil, now 67 and on trial for charges including kidnapping, sexual assault causing bodily harm and administering a stupefying drug.

articles.title: 3 candidates vying for front-runner status ahead of Mississauga election: poll
articles.summary: It's going to be a tight mayoral race in Mississauga with three candidates, including the current and former mayors, now neck and neck among decided and leaning voters, a new poll suggests.

articles.title: Man accused in massive gold heist at Toronto's Pearson airport pleads not guilty as trial begins
articles.summary: A man accused in what investigators have called one of the largest gold heists in Canadian history has pleaded not guilty to two charges as his trial begins in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: This heritage home may be paying the price of Toronto's electricity needs
articles.summary: A 145-year-old home near Kensington Market may soon be demolished — despite its status as a listed heritage site — after the building was reportedly bought earlier this year by Hydro One.
